blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines and the United States will pursue a military financing package worth more than $2 billion to strengthen the country’s defense capabilities. The proposed loan package was among the defense and economic commitments outlined by the White House in a fact sheet released Wednesday following US President Donald Trump’s visit to Manila. Under the proposed Foreign Military Financing loan package, the Philippines would acquire defense and security equipment from American suppliers. The White House did not disclose the proposed loan terms or a timetable for finalizing the package. READ: Trump: US to expand defense cooperation with Philippines Separately, […]...
